brief: Goldman Sachs sales recap of Day 1 of its Communacopia and Technology Conference in San Francisco, hosting 260 tech companies. It relays what nine managements said and advances no house view. Broadcom CEO Hock Tan tied AI value capture to frontier labs: a 1GW cluster generates roughly $30bn of revenue against about $10bn of annual operating costs, and frontier models take roughly 75% of industry revenue on investment similar to open-weight ecosystems, the frame behind reaffirmed FY27/FY28 AI revenue targets of $115bn and $230bn plus Google TPU work through 2031, an OpenAI custom silicon program and an Anthropic relationship. Cisco ran the same chain through networking: agents use roughly 5x the bandwidth of humans and run continuously, so campus growth goes from 3-4% to double digits, hyperscaler AI orders hit $9.3bn in FY26 and F2027 guidance holds at 15% revenue growth at the midpoint. Databricks and Snowflake both said enterprise agent deployment is early and that differentiation shifts to governance, cost routing and latency rather than proprietary storage. SAP, Visa, Reddit, Airbnb and TKO supplied operating metrics and internal AI productivity claims. Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky was skeptical chatbots become the dominant travel interface.
